selected: explicit Issue + uniform ROB completion/Commit + parallel PMA attributes
reasons: Explicit stage ownership replaces forced fetch FIFO latency.
Uniform ROB completion keeps Issue forwarding and removes FU-specific retirement muxes.
Parallel PMA changes timing, not measured 700 MHz cycles.
Mixed independent FUs improve, but MicroBench does not justify default ROB enablement.
rejected: Issue only: 680 MHz and larger area than uniform completion.
Claim that ROB speeds up all MicroBench workloads.
Extra arbitrary operand cache, extra LSU register, weakened constraints or changed delay model.
